e2e.v: 8-bit rolling sequence per ID + CRC-8 (SAE J1850 poly 0x1D, init 0xFF, final XOR 0xFF) over the preceding payload bytes; CMD_STATE key = 0xA500 | (cmd XOR 0x5A); ABORT magic 0xA5 0x5A

frames.0x020 FC->ECU CMD_FAST 500 Hz: len 8: [seq][thrust setpoint u16 0.1 N][gimbal a i16 0.001 deg][gimbal b i16 0.001 deg][crc8]
frames.0x024 FC->ECU FC_THRUST >= 100 Hz: len 5: [seq][thrust estimate u16 0.1 N][flags b0 valid][crc8]; accelerometer estimate, tau 20 ms
frames.0x028 FC->ECU CMD_AUX >= 50 Hz while wan: len 4: [seq][roll bits b0 CW b1 CCW][~roll bits][crc8]; dead-man 50 ms
frames.0x030 FC->ECU CMD_STATE event + 10 Hz: len 7: [seq][cmd][arg u16][key u16][crc8]; cmd = Cmd enum (types.h)
frames.0x100 ECU->FC TLM_FAST 500 Hz: len 8: [seq][state][Pc u16 kPa abs, 0xFFFF = invalid (RG-15)][pintle lift u16 um][fault bits u16]
frames.0x101 ECU->FC TLM_GIMBAL 500 Hz: len 8: [seq][flags][gimbal a meas i16][gimbal b meas i16][thrust u16 0.1 N, 0xFFFF when Pc invalid]
frames.0x102 ECU->FC TLM_RELIGHT 50 Hz: len 8: [seq][state][flags][relight worst u16 ms][P_feed/P_tank %, 0xFF invalid][refuse reason][crc8]
frames.0x110 ECU->FC TLM_SLOW 50 Hz: NOT DEFINED in v2.8.3 (page layout TO-DEFINE before the HAL)
